sentences.en: Snow falls silently and piles up ... on top of me.
sentences.zh: 1. 雪无声地落下，并堆积在我的身上。

sentences.en: The pile of garbage is as big as Mount Everest.
sentences.zh: 2. 垃圾堆有珠穆朗玛峰那么大。

sentences.en: Markku made his pile as a caterer for the well-to-do.
sentences.zh: 3. Markku作为一名为富人服务的承办商，积累了财富。
